title: The Promise of Junebug Creek
author: Sebastian Oyelaran
blurb: Rafael Halloran, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
